definitions.explanation: A dense forest found in areas of heavy rainfall, characterized by tall trees and rich biodiversity.

examples.japanese: {熱帯|ねったい}{雨林|うりん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
{雨林|うりん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}→動植物：23782_doushokubutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many animals and plants live in the rainforest.

examples.japanese: {雨林|うりん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伐採|ばっさい}→伐採：08435_bassai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}{温暖化|おんだんか}→地球温暖化：18873_chikyuuondanka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Deforestation of rainforests is contributing to global warming.

notes:
{雨林|うりん} means rainforest — a dense forest in a region of heavy rainfall. Compound of ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ (rain) + ⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧ (forest/woods).

USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the compound {熱帯|ねったい}{雨林|うりん} (tropical rainforest). Can stand alone to refer to any type of rainforest, but this is less common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱帯|ねったい}{雨林|うりん}: tropical rainforest
- {雨林|うりん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{破壊|はかい}→破壊：13678_hakai⟧: destruction of rainforests
- {雨林|うりん}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧: rainforest zone/region
- {雨林|うりん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧: rainforest conservation

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{森林|しんりん}→森林：01441_shinrin⟧: forest (general term)
- ⟦{密林|みつりん}→密林：19969_mitsurin⟧: dense jungle
- ⟦{原生林|げんせいりん}→原生林：09965_genseirin⟧: primeval/old-growth forest
